meta.note: Saturday briefing. Three top stories: copper plunges then surges (LME intraday +6.45% to about $12,595/t; SHFE copper CNY 93,660/t), memory divergence deepens as NAND turns toward oversupply, and the gallium/germanium/antimony suspension takes effect today, extended to 2027-01-27. Event library: 9 timeline entries added, 2 new events (Nucor hot-rolled coil's November streak of increases, EU heat-pump fluorinated-refrigerant exemption). Tier B batch 13: 11 subcategories, 3 with hits. Refrigerant spot: no Nov 27 daily quote; R32 uses the Nov 25 single-point price of CNY 65,500/t and R410A the Nov 23 East China price of CNY 59,000/t (both the latest verifiable and flat quotes).

headlines: Copper plunges then surges: LME copper intraday +6.45% to about $12,595/t; SHFE main contract closes at CNY 93,660/t
Memory divergence deepens, NAND turns toward oversupply: spot DDR5/DDR4 keep falling; TrendForce sees NAND turning down in 2027Q1
Gallium/germanium/antimony suspension takes effect as scheduled: extended from Nov 28 to 2027-01-27
daily_report.title: HVAC / Liquid-Cooling CDU Industry Intelligence Morning Briefing (2026-11-28 · Saturday)

hotspot_events.title: Copper plunges then surges: LME copper intraday +6.45% to about $12,595/t; SHFE main contract closes at CNY 93,660/t
hotspot_events.heat_reason: LME copper posted its biggest single-day intraday gain since January, and the SHFE main contract rose 5.51%; sharp copper swings hit HVAC copper costs directly
hotspot_events.summary: LME copper rose as much as 6.45% intraday on Nov 27 to about $12,595/t, its biggest single-day gain since January; the SHFE main contract closed at CNY 93,660/t (+5.51%). LME copper closed Nov 26 at $11,872/t (+1.91%), Shanghai spot premiums were about CNY 2,500/t, and national copper social inventories stood above 60,000 t.

hotspot_events.title: Memory divergence deepens, NAND turns toward oversupply: spot DDR5/DDR4 keep falling; TrendForce sees NAND turning down in 2027Q1
hotspot_events.heat_reason: Spot DRAM keeps falling while NAND is expected to turn oversupplied and HBM stays tight — memory divergence directly affects PCBA stocking pace
hotspot_events.summary: Spot DDR5 16Gb fell 0.71% and DDR4 16Gb fell 1.13% on Nov 27; TrendForce expects NAND contract prices to fall 0–5% QoQ in 2027Q1 and decline across the board from Q2 (Chinese cloud vendors cutting enterprise SSD orders; 2027 bit supply +25–30%). But HBM stays tight through 2028, with SK Hynix sold out through 2029; Micron rose 7.60% on Nov 27.

hotspot_events.title: Gallium/germanium/antimony suspension takes effect as scheduled: extended from Nov 28 to 2027-01-27
hotspot_events.heat_reason: The suspension under MOFCOM Announcement No. 59 takes effect today, giving gallium/germanium/antimony items a two-month window of certainty, though the military-use ban remains in force
hotspot_events.summary: MOFCOM Announcement No. 59 of 2026 extends the suspension of the gallium/germanium/antimony export ban on the U.S. to 2027-01-27, effective today, Nov 28; the ban on U.S. military users and military end uses remains in force — a suspension is not a green light.

industry_updates.title: LG discloses cumulative AI data-center cooling orders topping KRW 3 trillion
industry_updates.detail: About KRW 600 billion in H1, reaching KRW 3 trillion in Q3 (about 5x), driven mainly by last month's 5 GW long-term cooling contract with North American firm Air Control Concepts; the ES division's Jan–Sep equipment investment was KRW 192.7 billion (+168.4% YoY) (Aju Press, Nov 26)

industry_updates.title: Samsung doubles down on industrial HVAC and data-center cooling
industry_updates.detail: Completed the EUR 1.5 billion acquisition of FlaktGroup and is reportedly in talks to acquire U.S.-based Modin Manufacturing (Korean media say 'reportedly in progress', not officially confirmed); plans to invest KRW 240 billion in an HVAC production line at its Gwangju plant (Aju Press, Nov 26)

industry_updates.title: Otek Carrier wins cooling contracts for three edge data centers in downtown Seoul
industry_updates.detail: Samsung, LG and Carrier are all pushing into AI data-center cooling (Aju Press, Nov 26)

industry_updates.title: Lenovo's Tianjin high-performance server line starts production on Nov 25
industry_updates.detail: Annual capacity of 200,000 general-purpose and 100,000 AI servers; AI server order backlog of about CNY 530 billion (Industrial Economy Information Network, Nov 27)

industry_updates.title: Tongfei says order book is full and it has launched a full liquid-cooling solution
industry_updates.detail: Responded on its Nov 27 investor platform: order book is full and operations are sound; it has launched a full cold-plate and immersion liquid-cooling solution (CDU, Manifold, prefabricated piping, outdoor dry coolers, integrated cooling stations, immersion cooling TANKs) (China Securities Taurus, Nov 27)

industry_updates.title: Tariff policy check: gallium/germanium/antimony suspension takes effect Nov 28, extended to 2027-01-27
industry_updates.detail: The proposed 15% tariff on refined copper imports in the U.S. remains unapproved; prediction markets put about 91% odds on it not landing in 2026; Section 301 exclusions expire 2027-01-09 with no new updates; EU hybrid-car quota takes effect Dec 1 with no new developments (MOFCOM website, Nov 24; Federal Register, Nov 10; European Commission, Nov 24)

siphon_effects.detail: LME copper rose as much as 6.45% intraday on Nov 27 to about $12,595/t (biggest single-day gain since January); the SHFE main contract closed at CNY 93,660/t (+5.51%); U.S. hot-rolled coil prices hit a four-year high, with Bloomberg saying AI data-center construction is lifting demand (Reuters, Nov 27; Bloomberg, Nov 25)

LG's cumulative AI data-center cooling orders topped KRW 3 trillion and Samsung is doubling down on industrial HVAC and data-center cooling; Hitachi began promoting Bloom Energy fuel-cell systems in Japan on Nov 26 for the data-center power market (Aju Press, Nov 26; Korea Wind Intel, Nov 26)

Spot DDR5 16Gb fell 0.71% and DDR4 16Gb fell 1.13% on Nov 27; TrendForce expects NAND contract prices to fall 0–5% QoQ in 2027Q1 and decline across the board from Q2; the WSJ says the shortage will last at least until new plants come online in 2028 (TrendForce, Nov 27; WSJ, Nov 27)

1080 thin cloth at CNY 20.8/m (+13–14% MoM; +316% YTD) and 2116 thin cloth at CNY 20.2/m (+13–14% MoM; +312% YTD); Citi said on Nov 23 that supply stays tight in 2027 and only balances after new capacity comes online in 2028 (Citi China industrial survey, Nov 23)

Samsung Electro-Mechanics lead times are 52 weeks across the board (October data); some part numbers listed on DigiKey reached standard lead times of 61 weeks in October; consumer-grade X5R +25%–30% and AI-grade X6S +10%–20% in Q4 (TrendForce estimates); high-end shortages expected to persist into H1 2027 (TrendForce via NextPCB, Nov 12)

Taoguangdian Q4 high-end CCL +5%–20%, with long-term contract capacity visibility extended to 2030; Shengyi said on Nov 9 that CCL capacity is tight and another adjustment is expected this month; no news of resumption at Panasonic's Hukou plant (AHI Journal, Nov 9; 21 Finance, Nov 9)

cross_industry.detail: U.S. stocks rose across the board in the half-day session after Thanksgiving on Nov 27: the Dow +1.18% to 50,774.94, the S&P 500 +1.60% to 7,297.49, and the Nasdaq +2.31% to 24,129.50, led by a rebound in AI/chip stocks; for the week, the S&P +5.6%, the Dow +5.5%, the Nasdaq +6.7% (Associated Press, Nov 27)

December rate-hike odds rose to about 99%: CME FedWatch's Nov 27 snapshot showed 98.9%–99.2% (vs 97.4%–97.8% on Nov 25); cumulative odds of another hike by January are about 63.8%; FOMC meets Dec 8–9 (CME FedWatch, Nov 27)

EU Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2486 (published Nov 25): indoor brine-water/water-water heat pumps of 20–50 kW and dual-duct air-water heat pumps below 12 kW may continue using fluorinated refrigerants with GWP of 150 or higher in 2027 — a buffer year for exporters such as Midea, Haier and Gree in the European market in 2027 (Refrigeration Express, Nov 25)

South Korea's flat-steel exports to the U.S. rose 68% YoY in Jan–Oct; Vietnam's October import applications reached 213,000 net tons; Asian imported steel is still about $400/t cheaper than U.S. domestic steel after the 50% tariff and freight (Bloomberg via SMM / Yonhap, Nov 25)
The EU hybrid-car quota takes effect Dec 1 (extended, no new developments); the first quota runs to 2027-02-28, with 86,301 units for China in the first tranche (European Commission, Nov 24)

Neodymium oxide at CNY 741,500/t (Nov 27, Mysteel, flat vs Nov 25); SMM's Nov 27 daily review said rare-earth prices were running soft, with dysprosium and terbium falling together and praseodymium-neodymium steady; dysprosium oxide at CNY 1.47 million–1.49 million/t, falling (Mysteel, Nov 27; SMM, Nov 26–27)
